facts.fact: A MINPOSTEL notice of 3 October 2025 states that component 2 of PATNUC is to improve connectivity in public entities including the decentralised local authorities, financing LAN equipment and the purchase and deployment of bandwidth for each target entity; at that date it was seeking a consultant for a 120-day needs assessment to prepare the tender files, and nothing had been deployed.
facts.system: connectivité large bande des entités publiques (PATNUC)

facts.fact: The notice of 3 October 2025 places PATNUC, and its broadband connectivity for public entities including the decentralised local authorities, under the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications as contracting authority.
facts.system: connectivité large bande des entités publiques (PATNUC)

facts.fact: The notice of 3 October 2025 states that PATNUC is financed by a World Bank loan of US$100 million (IDA 69870-CM), from which the connectivity of public entities including the decentralised local authorities is to be paid; no domestic budget line is named.
facts.system: connectivité large bande des entités publiques (PATNUC)

systems.system: connectivité large bande des entités publiques (PATNUC)
systems.platform: LAN equipment (routers, Wi-Fi access points, firewalls), charging points and purchased bandwidth; technical options to be set by the study
systems.owner: MINPOSTEL, PATNUC project management unit; World Bank loan IDA 69870-CM
systems.tiers: decentralised local authorities (MINDDEVEL) with hospitals, schools, vocational training centres, women's and family centres and centres for disadvantaged persons; at the stage of a needs assessment in October 2025

note: The connection is planned, not live: the notice recruits a consultant to assess needs before any tender, so no fact is given for how offices are connected, what they do over it or how many are connected.
